_comment: Row 805. The gate judges every non-httpx egress site in bulk_downloader/ against the in-tree accounting declaration. M1 deletes the denominator collection, so the census returns an empty population that the declaration trivially matches -- the shape a census fails at silently; M2 deletes the stale-entry check, so a declared entry that names no site is never reported. Each anchor matches structural source text -- a bare statement line and a bare branch keyword line -- and carries no number, quoted value or assignment, so nothing here freezes a re-derived value (row 357).
subject: row 805 - the every-transport egress census and its in-tree accounting
